_comment: Hand-curated sources, merged on top of the discovered registry so they
always win over whatever discovery inferred.
1. A source neither catalog indexes (a bare CSV export, a feature
layer not published to ArcGIS Hub).
2. A source discovery finds but mis-labels — pin the jurisdiction,
state, or field_map by hand here.
Leave field_map/text_fields empty to have the connector introspect the
endpoint on first use; set them to override the heuristic mapping.
Set 'verified': true for a source to be included in a harvest.
The entry below is a working example (Chicago, whose schema splits the
address across three columns). Run `dcpermits inspect <endpoint>` to
generate the field_map for a new source.
